# Neural-Symbolic Reasoning on Edge Devices

Neural-symbolic networks integrate discrete graph reasoning with dense vector embeddings. Grounded in [[Genesis Architecture]] and [[4-Signal Knowledge Graph]], this paradigm enables persistent memory on low-power devices. Key entities include Zuri Edge and SmartGift.
